title: Taxes

filters.companyHint: Shows only the taxes of the chosen company, not the workspace-wide ones. Choose All to see everything.
filters.statusHint: Show active taxes, inactive taxes or both.
filters.inclusiveHint: Show only taxes that are included in the price, or only those added on top.

notices.companiesFailed: The company list could not be loaded, so company taxes can't be filtered or created.

empty: No taxes yet. Add the first one.

actions.deactivateDesc: Stop offering it on new documents.

fields.scopeHint: Workspace-wide applies everywhere; a company applies to that company only. Can't be changed later.
fields.codeHint: Up to 32 characters, unique in its scope, including inactive taxes. Can't be changed later.
fields.name: Name
fields.rateHint: A percentage from 0 to 100 with up to 4 decimals, such as 15 or 7.5.
fields.inclusiveHint: On when prices already contain this tax. Off when the tax is added on top.
fields.activeHint: Inactive taxes are not offered on new documents. A company tax can't be active while its company is inactive.

validation.rateInvalid: Enter a number from 0 to 100 with at most 4 decimals.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}} ({{code}})?
deactivate.text: The tax ({{rate}}%) will no longer be offered on new documents. Existing documents keep it, and you can reactivate it later.

unsaved.text: You have unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
